summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification (the UK equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D ownership disclosure). The Capital Group Companies, Inc. reported its aggregate stake fell to 17.975584% from 18.023677%, crossing the threshold on 4 November 2026 and notifying the issuer on 5 November 2026. The position comprises 287,637,213 ordinary shares (13.349128%) and 99,687,480 depositary receipts (4.626456%), with no voting rights held through financial instruments. This is a routine passive ownership update, not a special situation; watch for further incremental selling by the large holder.
